limitations: Synthetic single-host, single-thread observations, not real-data or cross-platform capacity evidence.
Cold means a fresh process with warm OS filesystem caches, not a cache-evicted machine.
Warm native timing includes spec parsing, fit and serialization; the Python timing includes request parsing, validation, fit and serialization.
Darwin maximum RSS is the OS-reported maximum, not a sum over simultaneously live processes. Memory has one separate observation per implementation/workload.
No parallel scaling claim; no conformal durable replay interface exists.

Eleven noisy panel workloads fail the unchanged SciPy precision-loss policy; those cannot establish independent optimizer parity or speedup. Fixed-parameter gradient/downstream checks are recorded separately. The large successful balanced-null case has zero logistic coefficients and does not exercise iterative-fitting scale.
This is a working-tree candidate binary, not a release binary or a completed migration.

fixed_parameter_audit.gradient_limit_rationale: native 1e-8 stationarity criterion plus 1e-9 absolute floating-reduction allowance, fixed before this audit
